reviews.review: Its good, enough. I mean its just like Destiney 2, but with hot ladies.

This feels like Destiny 2 meets Warframe in all the best ways. If you enjoy either of those games — especially both — you’re going to enjoy this. The first hour can seem a bit limited in enemy variety, but don’t let that put you off; it opens up quickly.
If you’re into loot and build‑crafting, there’s plenty here. If you’re not into stats and optimisation, it’s still a great time. The core gameplay is just fun.
I’m genuinely considering buying some premium currency purely to support the developers — it’s that solid.

For a FREE game I have no idea how it's sitting at "mixed"
Gave it a shot and I am having a great time, even if it gets worse after x hours, it's still x hours of fun and blasting.

[b]Excellent game, [/b]

I have literally written 0 reviews, while simultaneously having 4 games which i have played 3000+ hours, the omega list i like to call it. And i feel this could be my 5th.

[b]That being here is a list of things i want to happen:[/b]

1. [b]Movement:[/b] Warframe/Apex. What else could i really say, shift is doge/run, ctrl is slide/crouch. You slide and jump. You should be able to maneuver your jumps, and mid air directions. Falls should have weight.

2. [b]Minimalistic[/b] UI: The skill bar at the bottom irritates me to death, place it better, give me an option to size it, even better [i]bake[/i] a ultra minimal UI setup, [b]"Where i see the objective in hide ui"[/b], your game is gorgeous, let me see [i]it[/i] instead of ugly data. Also no sniper scope in ui free mode.

3. [b]Skirt toggle on Ultimate Bunny: [/b] I mean I'm down for the thing, we all are here for the thing, but sometimes i feel i want a skirt. I will buy skins eventually, till then i should be able to cover the bum of my fav character when i want. Fair i guess?

That's it, i will hop on everyday, control a beautiful being, merrily going map to map, in a beautiful world, without loading screens [i](no downtime, continuous action which i feel is better than warframe, being hub based limitation)[/i], slaying foes, without a care in the world.

Thank You
